_doc: Death causes for task 02 (needs, exposure, illness). Gentle wording on purpose: a quiet collapse, never a description of suffering.

starvation.label: Starvation
starvation.text: {name} was too weak after days without food and could not be woken.
starvation.legacy_text: They went without food for too long.
starvation.child_text: Why didn't anyone feed them? I don't understand.

exhaustion.label: Exhaustion
exhaustion.text: {name} lay down to rest, worn out for days, and did not wake again.
exhaustion.legacy_text: They were worn out and never got the rest they needed.
exhaustion.child_text: They were so tired. Why couldn't they sleep?

memory.text: how tired {name} was at the end

hypothermia.label: Cold
hypothermia.text: {name} was out in the freezing cold for too long and could not be warmed again.
hypothermia.legacy_text: They were caught out in the winter cold.
hypothermia.child_text: It was so cold out. They should have come inside.

heatstroke.label: Heatstroke
heatstroke.text: {name} was out in the burning heat for too long and could not be revived.
heatstroke.legacy_text: They were caught out in a scorching heatwave.
heatstroke.child_text: It was so hot. Why didn't they get some water?
